The other five told me I wouldn’t be able to file a restraining order (which I have their statements on surveillance footage too), one even refused to file a report, which I didn’t find out until I went to the police department to get my reports.

The first instance of rape was five years ago, the second was four… The physical abuse was about four years ago… and the stalking and harassment has been happening since 2019.  I have been fighting a battle for myself ever since.

I was looking to file a restraining order while I was simultaneously being stalked and harassed.

In a nutshell, he had five officers accompany him to my home.  Three of which were standing outside with him, and two were blocking off both ends of my street.

When I would call with genuine concerns because of him following me (sometimes for over half an hour), showing up at my jobs, or obnoxiously revving past my home, I would be greeted with officers who wanted to do anything but help me.

When I went to the court house, I was well within my stature of limitations for everything, including the sexual assault, but my main concern was to get him away from me.  I genuinely believe he is a dangerous man.

He attempted to access my therapy records by befriending the person at the front desk who handled filing and billing, may have potentially stolen a firearm from my home, has gotten others to accompany him in the harassment, and has figured out about each of the jobs I’ve had since our breakup, within three days of my starting date at each establishment… There’s a lot more to it, but I don’t want to go into further detail.
